provinces.name: Nunavut
story_threads: Nunavut posts the highest 2024 GDP read in the country (+7.5%) and simultaneously the highest unemployment (12.5%) - a structural pattern where territorial economy GDP is dominated by mining output that does not translate proportionally to local employment. The Iqaluit hydroelectric proposal is the first such record in the Nunavut pipeline.
Nunavut unemployment reads 12.5% and wage growth n/a y/y (change n/a) against a pipeline of 52 tracked projects led by infrastructure (16 projects), tourism_culture (6 projects), Other (4 projects).
IAAC monitoring: 0 active federal assessments for Nunavut. Top tracked story this cycle: Iqaluit Nukkiksautiit Hydroelectric Project Proposed - Nunavut's first major hydroelectric record.

cross_references.interpretation: Labour-sensitive sectors (healthcare, education, manufacturing, government, infrastructure) hold 20 projects in the Nunavut pipeline; an unemployment read of 12.5% sets the labour-cost backdrop for those records.

projects.name: Iqaluit Nukkiksautiit Hydroelectric Project
projects.description: A proposed 15-30 MW, 100% Inuit-owned hydroelectric facility on the Kuugaluk River (McKeand River South) near Iqaluit, Nunavut, intended to replace the city's diesel-generated electricity. The federal government is investing $6 million for engineering and design work. Project referred to the federal Major Projects Office; construction expected to begin 2028, operational by 2030.
